    local name=$1
    local price=$2
    local stock=$3
    local description=$4

    productNames["$name"]=$name
    productPrices["$name"]=$price
    productStocks["$name"]=$stock
    productDescriptions["$name"]=$description
}

# 显示所有商品
display_products() {
    echo -e "\n商品列表:"
    for name in "${!productNames[@]}"; do
        price="${productPrices[$name]}"
        stock="${productStocks[$name]}"
        description="${productDescriptions[$name]}"
        printf "%s - ￥%.2f (库存: %d) %s\n" "$name" "$price" "$stock" "$description"
    done
}

# 处理购买商品的操作
sell_product() {
    display_products

    echo -n "请输入您要购买的商品编号: "
    read productName

    if [[ -z "${productNames[$productName]}" ]]; then
        echo "无效商品名称！"
        return
    fi

    price="${productPrices[$productName]}"
    stock="${productStocks[$productName]}"
    description="${productDescriptions[$productName]}"

    if [ "$stock" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "该商品暂无库存！"
        return
    fi

    echo "您选择了 $productName，单价: ￥$price，库存: $stock 件，描述: $description"
    echo -n "请输入购买数量: "
    read quantity

    fi
}

    img = cv2.imread(image_path)
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    faces = face_cascade.detectMultiScale(gray, 1.1, 4)
    return faces
